verdict.rationale: Brex documents top-line budget assignment (brex-docs-10) and a Budgets API for managing Budgets and Spend Limits (brex-docs-5). Its controls are auto-enforced: limits, blocking of out-of-policy purchases, and rules on who must approve (brex-docs-9, brex-docs-36, brex-docs-8), with multi-level approval routing in bill pay (brex-docs-11). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of allocating budgets per team or project, detail on how budgets tie to individual card limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works in practice.
